name: msp-growth-site
description: SEO-optimised marketing site for an agency serving managed service providers.

scripts.serve: node build.js && node -e "import('node:http').then(async({default:h})=>{const{readFile,stat}=await import('node:fs/promises');const{join,extname}=await import('node:path');const T={'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.png':'image/png','.xml':'application/xml','.txt':'text/plain'};h.createServer(async(q,s)=>{let p=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);let f=join('dist',p);try{if((await stat(f)).isDirectory())f=join(f,'index.html')}catch{f=f.endsWith('.html')?f:join('dist',p,'index.html')};try{const b=await readFile(f);s.writeHead(200,{'content-type':T[extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(b)}catch{const b=await readFile('dist/404.html').catch(()=>'Not found');s.writeHead(404,{'content-type':'text/html'});s.end(b)}}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('http://localhost:8080'))})"
